findings.message: stated() only extracts `\w+=\S*` pairs and silently drops the rest of a `specclaw budget:` line. The no-silent-fallback rule covers only a non-digit `context=` and an unknown `role=`. Other malformations of the same line fall back to the agent type or the config cap with no error: an empty `context=`, a space after `=`, a capitalised key, a `:` separator, `role = x`, or an unknown key. CLAUDE.md says a stated role or context that does not parse is an error. Fix: tokenise the whole remainder of the line. Raise on any token that is not exactly `role=<non-empty>` or `context=<digits>`, and on an empty value. Extend the AC-6 table with these spellings.
findings.scenario: Prompt first line `specclaw budget: role=builder-backend context= 70000` (or `Context=70000`, or `context:70000`) at 170k context with gate=block → no error, the cap is the config 200k, and the call passes in silence instead of failing loud.

findings.message: tasks() matches task ids with `T[\w.-]*?`. Every other tasks.md parser (specclaw-synth-agent, specclaw-update-task-status) uses `T[0-9][0-9.a-z]*`. The two can disagree: any checklist item whose first word starts with `T` becomes a task here. Any `- Files:` or `- Context:` lines after it are then filed under that false task. Fix: use the same `T[0-9][0-9.a-z]*` id rule, ideally shared, and add a table test with `Tests pass`, `TODO` and `The gate` checkboxes.
findings.scenario: change.md (lean, read when there is no tasks.md) holds `- [ ] Tests pass on CI` among its checkboxes → `specclaw-budget estimate` prints `Tests unsized` and exits 1 on every run, so plan step 4b can never reach exit 0.

findings.message: load() warns on bad values under `roles`, `routing` and `gate`, but ignores an unknown or misspelled key directly under `budget:` with no warning. A typo in a key name then reads as an unconfigured block, and the permissive defaults stand in silence. Round 9 closed this path for role entries only (B1). Fix: warn on any key of `raw` not in {gate, roles, routing}, and add variant tests (`role:`, `gates:`, `Gate:`).
findings.scenario:
config `budget:
  gates: block
  role:
    code-reviewer:
      context: 100000` → `roles --json` exits 0 with no stderr, code-reviewer is 150000 `source: default`, and the gate runs on warn, not block.

findings.message: read_tokens() counts 0 characters for any Files entry that is not a regular file. One `0` therefore stands for both "the file does not exist yet" (intended) and "this entry could not be measured": a directory, a glob, or a path with a suffix such as `:10-40`. The task reads as small and passes the 60000 split check. Fix: count 0 only for a path that does not exist. Report a directory, a glob, or any other unmeasurable entry as unsized or refused, and add a table test.
findings.scenario: tasks.md `- Files: src/api/` (a directory holding 400 KB of source) → `estimate` prints `read=26000 context=26000` and exits 0, so a task that will read about 200k tokens is never split.

findings.message: plan.md and templates/tasks.md now list `frontend | backend` as Kind values that `build.dynamic_agents` consumes. specclaw-synth-agent accepts only docs|test|config|refactor|impl|migration, so `Kind: frontend` or `Kind: backend` hits its invalid_kind path and falls back to heuristic classification. Fix: either teach synth-agent the two new kinds, or say in the docs that they only route through budget.routing.
